ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
As shown in the figure, in a uniform electric field, a small ball of mass m and charge quantity +q is released from rest and moves in a straight line obliquely downward. The trajectory makes an angle θ with the vertical direction. Then
A. The minimum value of the field strength is $\frac{mg}{q}$
B. The direction of the electric field may be horizontally to the left
C. The electric field force may do no work on the small ball
D. The electric potential energy of the small ball may increase
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Multi-Physics open-ended question 1

The trajectory makes an angle θ with the vertical direction. How much work may the electric field force do on the small ball during its motion?

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In a uniform electric field, a small ball of mass m and charge quantity +q is released from rest and moves in a straight line obliquely downward. The trajectory makes an angle θ with the vertical direction. How much work may the electric field force do on the small ball during its motion?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows: The small ball is released from an upper position; next to it there is a vertically downward reference line; another straight line obliquely downward to the right represents the small ball's motion trajectory, and the trajectory makes an angle θ with the vertical direction. From the meaning of the problem, the small ball carries positive charge +q, and in the uniform electric field it is subject to constant gravity mg and constant electric field force qE; also because the small ball is released from rest and moves along a straight line, its resultant force direction must be consistent with the obliquely downward displacement direction. If the direction of the electric field force is made always perpendicular to the small ball's obliquely downward trajectory, then the work done by the electric field force on the displacement along the trajectory is W_e = F_e s cos90° = 0. At the same time, the magnitude of the electric field force can be selected so that it just offsets the component of gravity perpendicular to the trajectory, namely making the resultant force of gravity mg and the electric field force be along the trajectory direction; therefore this motion situation can be realized. Therefore the work done by the electric field force on the small ball may be 0.

method.method_draft: 从图中读取小球的运动轨迹是一条斜向下直线，且与竖直方向成角θ。由题干读取：小球带正电+q、处在匀强电场中、由静止释放，因此受恒定重力mg和恒定电场力qE，合力恒定；由静止开始做直线运动时，位移方向必须与合力方向一致。要判断电场力做功是否可能为0，只需构造一种满足条件的电场力方向：令电场力始终垂直于斜向下的运动轨迹，则电场力对任意沿轨迹的位移做功W_e=F_e s cos90°=0。同时可以选取其大小使重力mg与该垂直轨迹的电场力的合力恰好沿轨迹方向，因此这种情况物理上可实现。所以电场力做功可能为0。
